title: Glowing bus
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='72' r='9' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='72' r='6' fill='#555577'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#99AADD'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='9' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='6' fill='#555577'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#99AADD'/>
  <!-- Bus body main -->
  <rect x='8' y='30' width='82' height='38' rx='6' fill='#FF6644'/>
  <!-- Bus body top lighter shade -->
  <rect x='8' y='30' width='82' height='10' rx='6' fill='#FF8866'/>
  <!-- Roof -->
  <rect x='10' y='26' width='78' height='8' rx='4' fill='#FF4422'/>
  <!-- Front bumper -->
  <rect x='78' y='62' width='14' height='8' rx='3' fill='#FFAA66'/>
  <!-- Headlight -->
  <ellipse cx='90' cy='55' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#FFFFAA'/>
  <ellipse cx='90' cy='55' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Windows row -->
  <rect x='14' y='36' width='14' height='14' rx='2' fill='#7EE8FA'/>
  <rect x='32' y='36' width='14' height='14' rx='2' fill='#7EE8FA'/>
  <rect x='50' y='36' width='14' height='14' rx='2' fill='#7EE8FA'/>
  <rect x='68' y='36' width='12' height='14' rx='2' fill='#7EE8FA'/>
  <!-- Window shine -->
  <rect x='16' y='38' width='4' height='7' rx='1' fill='#CCFFFF'/>
  <rect x='34' y='38' width='4' height='7' rx='1' fill='#CCFFFF'/>
  <rect x='52' y='38' width='4' height='7' rx='1' fill='#CCFFFF'/>
  <rect x='70' y='38' width='3' height='7' rx='1' fill='#CCFFFF'/>
  <!-- Door -->
  <rect x='82' y='40' width='6' height='22' rx='2' fill='#FFAA88'/>
  <rect x='85' y='48' width='1.5' height='4' rx='0.5' fill='#FFDDAA'/>
  <!-- Side stripe -->
  <rect x='10' y='58' width='78' height='4' fill='#FFDD44'/>
  <!-- Glow effect under bus -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='84' rx='40' ry='5' fill='#FF6644' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- Headlight glow -->
  <circle cx='90' cy='55' r='10' fill='#FFFFAA' opacity='0.2'/>
</svg>
